ai_review.summary: Marked‑up recording with a standout 72‑minute Bird Song and a hefty Other One, offering clearer sound than previous sources
ai_review.review: The taper’s master provides a noticeable improvement over earlier releases, delivering a cleaner mix that lets the marathon Bird Song and the expansive Other One shine. Reviewers praise these two jams as the highlights of the show, indicating strong musical energy despite limited detail on the overall set.

ai_rating.rationale: Only a single 4‑star review; positive remarks about both performance and recording suggest a solid show with good audio, but limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a marked improvement over existing versions, implying clearer, more balanced sound; no specific issues noted.
